content.text: Digital creators in the Philippines often face major challenges when trying to monetize their work. Conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are not available, forcing these creators to seek [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-honest-side-side-16|alternatives]]. This lack of accessible [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-8|The Full]] can lead to lost sales and frustration. However, Google Apps Script offers a way forward. By leveraging this powerful automation tool, you can create a seamless digital commerce experience without relying on restricted payment platforms. In conjunction with the Edge Commerce Stack, you can establish a fully functional online store that empowers you to take control of your digital transactions.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language for light-weight application development in the G Suite platform. In the context of digital commerce, it can automate tasks such as order processing, inventory updates, and customer notifications. For digital creators who cannot use Stripe or PayPal, Google Apps Script provides an essential way to maintain streamlined operations without traditional payment processors. This solution is vital as it allows you to create a fully operational store that functions independently. By controlling the backend processes, you can ensure that your business runs smoothly, ultimately leading to increased sales and customer satisfaction.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of your digital commerce setup involves a few essential components that work together seamlessly. Google Apps Script serves as the backend logic to handle incoming orders and customer interactions. When a customer makes a purchase, data is processed and sent to your chosen storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets. This ensures that all transactions are logged securely. The NOWPayments webhook then verifies the payment on-chain and triggers automated actions in Google Apps Script. This end-to-end process ensures that customers receive their products instantly, while you retain complete control and ownership of your data and infrastructure. This architecture eliminates dependency on conventional platforms, giving you the sovereignty to operate freely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment solutions are either unavailable or severely restricted. If you are an ebook author, course creator, or digital product seller in the Philippines, the Edge Commerce Stack is tailored for you. By using Google Apps Script for automation, you can effectively handle sales and fulfillments while minimizing the friction typically associated with payment processing. The design is purposeful, enabling you to focus on your craft rather than getting bogged down by technical barriers. This is about creating an ecosystem where you can thrive, unencumbered by the limitations imposed by conventional payment platforms.
Empower your digital commerce without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To achieve a successful digital commerce setup, several key components need to be in place. You will utilize Google Apps Script for backend logic, which orchestrates various functions like order processing and inventory management. For order storage, either Supabase or Google Sheets can be implemented, allowing you to manage customer data and transaction records effectively. The NOWPayments service provides automatic payment processing via cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring that you can accept payments without the hassle of complicated integrations. Lastly, by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, you can ensure that your customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation. Together, these components create a cohesive framework for your online store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital commerce setup, begin by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack for a comprehensive solution tailored to your needs. Start by setting up a Cloudflare Pages site, which requires creating an account and deploying your static assets. Then, use Google Apps Script to develop the backend processes needed for handling orders. Ensure that your order storage solution is set up—either Supabase or Google Sheets will work. Next, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing, following the straightforward integration guide provided in your purchase. Finally, configure automatic notifications using Gmail or Resend to keep your customers informed about their purchases. After testing the entire workflow, you’ll be ready to launch.

This tool handles backend logic for order processing, integrates with storage solutions, and works with NOWPayments for seamless payment verification. By deploying these resources, you can build an efficient digital storefront tailored to your needs.

For just $197, you gain access to a powerful combination of tools that will empower your online store without the constraints of conventional payment platforms. This stack is designed specifically for creators in regions where traditional methods like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack to access the essential tools for your digital commerce infrastructure. 2. Set up a Cloudflare Pages account and deploy your static assets to create a website. 3. Develop backend logic using Google Apps Script to manage orders and automate processes. 4. Choose either Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage to keep track of transactions and customer data. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment processing and verify transactions. 6. Configure Gmail or Resend for sending instant customer notifications about order confirmations and delivery. 7. Test the entire system to ensure smooth operation before launching your store.

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting platform that allows users to automate tasks across Google Workspace applications. It can be used to create custom applications, streamline workflows, and enhance productivity.

Yes, you can utilize your existing Google account to access Google Apps Script and other Google services, making it convenient to deploy your digital commerce infrastructure.

You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, and software, making it flexible for various types of creators.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30 days of support, ensuring you have the assistance needed to resolve any issues or questions as you launch your store.
